papers.title: Rapid fabrication of bulk-form TiB2/316L stainless steel nanocomposites with novel reinforcement architecture and improved performance by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, University of California Los Angeles, Los Angeles, CA, 90095, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Bandar AlMangour
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, University of California Los Angeles, Los Angeles, CA, 90095, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注TiB2/316L不锈钢纳米复合材料的制备与力学性能，未涉及生物医学植入体的应力屏蔽、多孔结构或骨整合等关键方向。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue testing under physiological conditions, surface roughness, or osseointegration evaluation related to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过SLM快速制备TiB2/316L不锈钢纳米复合材料并改善力学性能
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化技术制备不同TiB2含量的纳米复合材料
summary_zh.result: TiB2添加显著提高了硬度、耐磨性和压缩强度
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构表征和力学测试验证性能提升

summary_en.motivation: To rapidly fabricate bulk-form TiB2/316L stainless steel nanocomposites with enhanced mechanical performance via selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to consolidate 316L stainless steel powder with varying TiB2 nanoparticle content.
summary_en.result: Incorporation of TiB2 nanoparticles significantly improved hardness, wear resistance, and compressive strength of the nanocomposites.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization and mechanical tests (hardness, compression, wear) validated the property enhancement.

papers.title: Study of Internal Channel Surface Roughnesses Manufactured by Selective Laser Melting in Aluminum and Titanium Alloys
papers.first_author_affiliation: Center for Space Human Robotics, Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia, Turin, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Jukka Pakkanen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for Space Human Robotics, Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia, Turin, Italy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选择性激光熔化制造铝合金和钛合金内部通道的表面粗糙度，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等生物医学核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on surface roughness characterization of SLM internal channels in non-biomedical alloys (Al, Ti), with no link to stress shielding, fatigue testing, osseointegration, or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 表征SLM制造内部通道的表面粗糙度特性
summary_zh.method: 使用SLM制备铝合金和钛合金内部通道样品并测量粗糙度
summary_zh.result: 发现工艺参数对表面粗糙度有显著影响，不同材料表现不同
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面粗糙度测量仪进行实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the surface roughness of internal channels fabricated by selective laser melting in aluminum and titanium alloys.
summary_en.method: Samples with internal channels were manufactured by SLM using AlSi10Mg and Ti6Al4V powders, and surface roughness was measured using a profilometer.
summary_en.result: Surface roughness was significantly influenced by process parameters, with distinct behaviors observed for the two alloys.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through direct roughness measurement on fabricated channels.
